decisions.decision: Treat Morpho Watch market 0xd4a... as a candidate cbXRP/USDC Base market, not a verified Coinbase retail loan book.
reason: Coinbase confirms Morpho/Base and XRP eligibility but does not publish the exact market ID
candidate market LLTV 62.5% conflicts with Coinbase generic 86% LTV language
candidate market positions exceed Coinbase retail XRP loan cap
required_verification: query Morpho market config and state at one block
read oracle price and last_updated_at at the same block
enumerate all positions and liquidation events from Base logs
reconcile user positions to Coinbase interface only where public evidence permits

decisions.decision: Do not admit Morpho Watch aggregate collateral, borrower counts or liquidation-risk map as model features until independently reconstructed.
reason: Morpho REST does not provide aggregate collateral totals, USD market metrics or a complete list of positions
required_verification: record chain ID, block number, transaction hash and log index
reconstruct total collateral and borrower position distribution
decode liquidation events and debt repaid separately from collateral seized
store oracle quote, provider, timestamp and last indexed block
cross-check totals against Morpho Watch and Coinbase cbXRP PoR

decisions.decision: Separate net external cash, stablecoin mint/burn, spot turnover, collateral encumbrance, borrowing, custody movements, internal exchange transfers, derivatives notional and mark-to-market valuation.
reason: USDC borrowed against cbXRP is credit, not proof of fresh XRP buying
Coinbase reserves back the wrapper but are not themselves a purchase flow
stablecoin reserve income and exchange revenue are operating economics, not XRP inflows

decisions.decision: Keep Tokyo SBIC distinct from SBI Holdings/SBI Group.
reason: SBIC's official name, act, independent status and sister-company structure differ from SBI Holdings
ChatGPT course was educational training for SBIC investee companies only

decisions.decision: No directional XRP forecast; no Morpho feature admitted.
reason: market mapping, liquidation metrics and raw onchain position distribution remain unverified

next_model_features: liquidation collateral seized versus debt repaid
redemption of cbXRP into native XRP
Coinbase/Circle USDC balances and reserve-income sensitivity to policy rates
RLUSD issuance, exchange distribution and collateral availability
